newsitem.title: USA: Search to acquire MS Financial.
newsitem.headline: Search to acquire MS Financial.

text.p: Search Capital Group Inc and MS Financial Inc said on Friday that Search agreed to acquire MS Financial, a non-prime auto finance company, in a stock swap valued at $21 million.
Added revenues from MS's portfolio and elimination of duplicate operations should increase Search's earnings for the year ended March 31, 1998, the companies said.
MS shareholders will receive the equivalent of $2.00 of Search common stock for each share held, the companies said.
There are about 10.4 million shares of MS Financial outstanding, the companies said.
MS Financial's two principal stockholders agreed to vote their 77 percent stake of the company in favor of the merger, the companies said.
